items.title: Cancer Vaccine Breakthrough Lifts 5 Biotech Names. Here’s Who’s Best Positioned.
items.summary: Merck and Moderna just proved their cancer vaccine works, and the ripple effects reach far beyond either company. Five names stand to collect a toll on every single dose manufactured, but not all of them carry the same risk.

items.title: Moderna Shares Rebound After Pullback Following Cancer Vaccine Rally
items.summary: Moderna (NASDAQ:MRNA) shares rose 2. 9% in pre-market trading, recovering some ground after several sessions of declines that followed a dramatic rally triggered by positive Phase 3 results for its personalised mRNA cancer vaccine, intismeran autogene.

items.title: Eli Lilly Stock Raised Its Forecast, So Why Is The Market Shrugging?
items.summary: Management is betting on a bigger year than ever, but investors seem to be waiting for a catch.

items.title: Myriad Genetics and Moderna Shares Plummet, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after shares across biotech and big pharma cooled further as traders continued to secure profits following the extraordinary run. The sector had jumped after Phase 3 results for Moderna’s individualized neoantigen mRNA therapy, intismeran, used with Merck’s Keytruda — the first positive late-stage readout for an mRNA-based cancer vaccine over Keytruda alone. items.title: GILD Stock Garners Retail Attention On Trodelvy EU Approval Ahead Of August 27 HIV FDA Verdict
items.summary: The European Commission on Monday authorized Trodelvy combined with Merck’s (MRK) Keytruda for certain adults with previously untreated advanced or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer.

items.title: Moderna Stock Had A Readout Waiting In Plain Sight
items.summary: Before the melanoma result, the visible signs were an enrolled trial, a partner paying half its cost, and a market that had stopped pricing an unusually large move.

items.title: Analysts See Drastic Change For This Particular Part Of Healthcare
items.summary: The biotech fund is one of two ETFs in IBD Leaderboard.  The S&P 500 Biotech index gapped up to nearly an all-time high last Wednesday, a bullish day for the industry.  While Moderna shares have remained volatile since then — down 23.5% Thursday after rising 177% Wednesday — the biotech ETF is doing its job as a diversified fund, keeping its one-day price moves to within 6%.
